result:
Here's how I read the spec: members with a lane booking get a text at 18:00 the evening before, so fewer lanes sit empty while the waiting list misses out. Anyone who ticked "no texts, please" gets nothing.

From the booking app:

- **Sending texts is already set up.** The club texts its newsletter through an SMS provider, so reminders can use the same account. Nothing sends reminders today.
- **About a quarter of members would get no reminder.** 23% of members have "no texts" ticked. Email can't cover most of them, because 61% of members have no email address on file. If you want those members reminded, my proposal is to email the ones who have an address and accept that the rest get nothing. Say if you'd rather do something else.

Correct anything I've got wrong.

The open question that changes the build most is what a member can do with the reminder:

- **Reminder only.** "You're booked for lane 3 at 07:00 tomorrow." This is simple, but someone who can't come still leaves the lane empty unless they cancel in the app.
- **Reply CANCEL to free the lane.** The lane goes back to the next person on the waiting list. This means handling incoming texts and connecting to the waiting list. It's more work, but it's the part that actually gets lanes to waiting-list members.

I'd go with reply-to-cancel, since filling empty lanes is the point. Which fits what you want?

Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
